title: EPISERVE FAIR Digital Object, version 1
description: The metadata record (<QID>.fdo.json) of an object on the EPISERVE platform: a raw or processed dataset, a model run or a benchmark. All of them share one envelope: a kernel (identifier, type, components), a schema.org profile and provenance. Full text: README.md of this spec.

@context.description: JSON-LD context; the FDO context comes first, followed by the prefixes schema, prov and fdo.

@id.description: The object's QID; a raw dataset's carries the suffix -raw.

conformsTo.description: Names this spec version. Optional: a document without it is recognised by its @type and kernel.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: Model runs only: the activity that produced the object; names the provenance block.

digitalObjectType.description: Every object on the platform is a set of files, so the type is Dataset; what kind of object it is shows in the profile and the provenance.

immutable.description: true for a finalized benchmark; false for the rest.

@id.description: Unique within the object: '#<componentId>' next to a single file, or the file's path below the object ('components/...').

componentId.description: The file name; what DOIP and the API address the component by.

display_name.description: The title shown in the catalog. Not a schema.org term; an EPISERVE addition that the catalog, the lineage and the theme read. Falls back to name.

url.description: Where the data comes from (a dataset), or the model image (a model run); empty for a benchmark.

additionalType.description: The catalog category of a dataset (incidence, surveillance, ...), or 'benchmarks'.

license.description: A CKAN licence id such as cc-by.

accessRights.description: restricted: files are served with a signed link only.

episerveBenchmark.description: Benchmarks only: the pinned input and reference files.
